name: Salmon Resiliency Grant Program
summary: CAD 50,000 a year for one or up to two years to British Columbia First Nations and First Nation-led organisations for salmon monitoring, habitat restoration, watershed stewardship and stewardship capacity.
reporting: Two reports per year: an interim progress report and a final report on annual outcomes, lessons learned and use of funds, through online forms; due dates are set in the grant agreement.

status.quote: The 2026 Salmon Resiliency Grant Program funding recipients have been selected and applications are now closed.

applicant_types.quote: First Nations in British Columbia (B.C) First Nation-led organizations in B.C., including but not limited to: Tribal councils First Nation alliances First Nation-mandated societies First Nation fisheries or stewardship authorities First Nation individual who have the letter of support from the community

geography.quote: provides one-year and multi-year (up to two years) funding to support First Nations in British Columbia

access.quote: Previous grantees may apply again in a new intake year.

window.quote: One application per First Nation or First Nation organization may be submitted per intake under this program.

amount.quote: Successful applicants receive CAD $50,000 per year.

co_finance_required.quote: Are matching funds required? No, matching funds are not required under this program.

reporting.quote: Successful applicants are required to submit two reports per year.
